comment: Host-provided header registry for check_header_closure.py. A shipped header may reference a header outside its shipped set only when that header is registered here for the scope, with the provider named. Registering a header is a deliberate act: it states which external header set the package relies on for that name. The browser scope is empty by design: the browser sysroot is freestanding and must be self-contained.
